outcome: Neurological signs (mild incoordination of hind limbs, posterior ataxia, severe neurological signs)
Microscopic lesions consistent with Teschovirus encephalomyelitis
cohort: The study participants were 5-week-old cesarean derived and colostrum-deprived pigs.
finding: Experimental inoculation with PTV-2 and PTV-11 demonstrated neuropathogenicity, with PTV-11 causing severe neurological signs and both serotypes leading to microscopic lesions consistent with Teschovirus encephalomyelitis.
